title: Compare reviewed development cases
scenario: Python 3.11+. Generate and explicitly review synthetic cases with the in-tree Store, then freeze and report supplied observations. Four English/Korean development cases; no credentials or model calls.

steps.title: Freeze reviewed public exports
steps.instruction: Prepare a synthetic case with evidence-bound instruction triage, review its exact digest, and export the detached public v1 JSON. Run evaluation.py qualify, then freeze a reviewed spec with both arms, reproduction/counterpart inputs, identities, repetitions and declared budgets. The producer and evaluator are in this checkout.
steps.caption: Actual upper portion of the current catalog dialog; its source link opens the complete contract.
steps.expected: One frozen inventory binds all scheduled trials. Private feedback and lineage are excluded. Unknown or changed export fields are refused.

steps.title: Inspect every matched pair
steps.instruction: Run evaluation.py report with the unchanged spec and supplied synthetic completions. Read counts and coverage, then paired_summary.overall and paired_summary.dimensions[primary_metric]. Missing, duplicate, blocked and inconclusive evidence stays unresolved. Retain separate routing, adherence and MCP dimensions.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered summary from the actual 30-call disposable CLI workflow; not a terminal capture.
steps.expected: All 16 scheduled trials remain visible. Eight pairs: one improved, one regressed, one both-pass, one both-fail and four unresolved. Unknown tokens remain null; live eligibility is false and promotion is inconclusive.
